source.title: Natural Earth 1:50m Admin 0 Countries
source.geographicBasis: WGS84 generalized present-day country polygons simplified at 0.02 degrees and subdivided to at most 1 degree angular edges

limitations: Present-day locator only; not historical borders.
Segments without Cao static-fragment ownership remain unavailable at every age greater than 0 Ma.

Complement segments that share a float32 endpoint with an accepted native segment are rebound to that segment's Cao static fragment by the source-fragment bridge; only the remaining 322 keep the exact-present locator chart.
The complement is derived against the released native line asset and does not alter historical chart ownership.
The complement retains 571 reverse-oriented shared-border pairs because each Natural Earth country source subdivision keeps its own country identity.
